import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive customer segmentation insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Calculate total spending and age
df['TotalSpending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                       df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
df['TotalChildren'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Education
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
education_order = df.groupby('Education')['Income'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
for edu in education_order:
    mask = df['Education'] == edu
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Income'], df[mask]['TotalSpending'], alpha=0.5, label=edu, s=30)
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education Level', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Education', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=30, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. Spending by category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                       'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
category_names = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
spending_means = [df[cat].mean() for cat in spending_categories]
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(category_names))
ax3.barh(category_names, spending_means, color=colors, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Average Spending by Product Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 4. Purchase channels comparison
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
channel_names = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals']
channel_totals = [df[ch].sum() for ch in channels]
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('pastel', len(channel_names))
ax4.pie(channel_totals, labels=channel_names, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_pie)
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Purchase Channels', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Marital Status distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
ax5.bar(range(len(marital_counts)), marital_counts.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(marital_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(marital_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Marital Status Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Total Spending by Number of Children
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
children_spending = df.groupby('TotalChildren')['TotalSpending'].mean()
ax6.bar(children_spending.index, children_spending.values, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Number of Children', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Spending vs Number of Children', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 7. Campaign Acceptance Rate
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
campaigns = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
campaign_names = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = [(df[cmp].sum() / len(df)) * 100 for cmp in campaigns]
colors_bar = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(campaign_names))
ax7.bar(campaign_names, acceptance_rates, color=colors_bar, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax7.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')
ax7.set_ylim(0, max(acceptance_rates) * 1.2)

# 8. Income distribution by Marital Status
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
marital_income = [df[df['Marital_Status'] == status]['Income'].dropna() for status in marital_counts.index]
bp = ax8.boxplot(marital_income, labels=marital_counts.index, patch_artist=True)
for patch in bp['boxes']:
    patch.set_facecolor('lightblue')
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax8.set_xticklabels(marital_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax8.set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Income by Marital Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
